summary: Lanvin Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its H1 2026 earnings release and presentation under Rule 13a-16. The report discloses revenue of 101 million, down 13% year-over-year, with gross margin expanding to 59% and improved adjusted EBITDA margins. No transaction, tender offer, activist involvement, strategic review, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, incorporating exhibits into existing F-3 registration statements. The content is operational performance commentary, not a corporate action warranting special-situations classification.
